agronomicAdvice: Cordana leaf spot is exacerbated by high relative humidity (>85%) and poor canopy air circulation in dense plantations.
Prune and de-leaf severely infected or necrotic banana foliage to diminish local fungal inoculum.
Improve drainage ditches in the plantation to prevent waterlogging during monsoonal downpours.
Apply protective bio-fungicide or copper-based formulations on young developing leaves during sustained humid spells.
